value.rationale: A natural graph of experimentally studied Keplerate spin clusters exhibits a complete, exact finite classification for placement of two absorbing contacts: 15 antipodal placements are highly redundant, 60 intermediate placements have a distinct trapping fraction, and no pair captures more than 13/30 of a uniformly mixed excitation. The sharp failure of graph distance alone to predict asymptotic capture is a motivated structural result useful for coherent transport design.
